title: Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange Hold Amount
content:
On a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange the replacement ships before the original units come back, so the cardholder's card carries a hold. This calculation sets the hold amount.

## Hold amount

1. **Replacement value.** The booked unit price of the order line being exchanged, times its units authorized on the exchange.
2. **Sales tax on the value.** The order's sales tax, times the replacement value, divided by the order's net merchandise at placement (merchandise subtotal less discount total).
3. **Hold amount.** The replacement value plus the sales tax on that value, added once and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

The line being exchanged and its units authorized are read from the return's line authorization; the price, sales tax and placement figures from the Online Orders record of the order.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Booked unit price of the exchanged line | 89.00 |
| Units authorized on the exchange | 1 |
| Replacement value | 89.00 |
| Order's sales tax; net merchandise at placement | 12.00; 150.00 |
| Sales tax on the value | 12.00 times 89.00 divided by 150.00, that is 7.12 |
| Hold amount | 96.12 |

With 2 units of the same line authorized, the replacement value is 178.00, the tax 14.24 and the hold 192.24.
